cases.prompt:
Is this page ready for launch from an SEO point of view? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files. ```html Home

Welcome

Our services

```
criteria: Flags noindex as a launch blocker
Flags the generic 'Home' title and missing meta description
Flags multiple h1 elements
Mentions Open Graph / social preview tags
Mentions canonical, sitemap or robots.txt

cases.prompt: We use Google Analytics and a Meta pixel on our EU client's site, loaded on every page immediately. Our footer says '100% GDPR compliant'. Anything to fix? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Says analytics and marketing pixels must wait for consent
Says the consent banner must allow rejecting as easily as accepting
Flags '100% GDPR compliant' as an unsupported claim
Recommends a privacy/cookie policy listing the third parties
Recommends human legal review rather than definitive legal advice

cases.prompt: Our site claims to be available in English and Spanish, but the checkout shows `checkout.submit_button` on the Spanish version and dates look like 09/30/2026 for Spanish users. Is it OK to announce multilingual support? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Says raw translation keys visible to users are a blocker
Flags locale-incorrect date format
Says the multilingual claim should wait until fixed
Recommends checking for hardcoded strings and fallbacks

cases.prompt: When users paste our blog links into Twitter/X, Slack, and LinkedIn, no preview image or description appears. How do we configure social share metadata properly? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Specifies Open Graph tags: og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url
Specifies Twitter card tags: twitter:card (summary_large_image), twitter:title, twitter:image
Recommends absolute URLs for images and canonical link
Mentions recommended image aspect ratio (1200x630)

cases.prompt: What is the difference between peerDependencies and dependencies in package.json? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Explains peerDependencies expects the host/consuming app to provide the package
Explains dependencies installs packages locally in node_modules
Mentions peerDependenciesMeta and optional peer dependencies

cases.prompt: How does the 'satisfies' operator in TypeScript differ from type annotation (e.g. const x: Type = ...)? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Explains satisfies validates against a type without widening or losing specific inferred types
Gives a concrete example showing property inference preservation
Explains that type annotation widens properties to the declared interface
